analysis_goal: The diagram must make clear the main data entities stored by the system, their relationships, and which information must be persisted throughout the lifecycle of a report.

analysis_tasks.goal: Identify the main data entities and their relationships within the persistence layer regarding municipal reports
expected_evidence: types representing entities and their relations

analysis_tasks.goal: Identify specific information within the persistence layer that must be persisted throughout the lifecycle of a report
expected_evidence: types handling users, locations, categories, states, state changes, internal notes, and notifications

analysis_tasks.goal: Locate extension points or modular boundaries designed to support future changes to the management of municipal reports
expected_evidence: types implementing extension points or modular boundaries

analysis_tasks.goal: Identify which parts of the application depend on the persisted information managed by the persistence layer
